projection.purpose: Expose the same portable command boundary to a browser.

contract.input: Validated command envelopes and host-injected ticks.
contract.step: Translate bytes and handles without duplicating gameplay rules.
Return permitted player data separately from diagnostics.
contract.invariant: The browser cannot set stress, knowledge or inventory directly.

test.given: Native and WASM hosts receive the same scripted commands.
test.then: Compare semantic frames and receipts, independent of layout.
